title: Tesla invites select customers to buy Cybercab for personal use
excerpt: Tesla is offering select customers the chance to purchase a steering-wheel-free Cybercab for personal use, subject to specific geographic limits.
body_html:
Tesla has begun offering select customers the opportunity to purchase a Cybercab for personal use. The two-seater vehicle features a steering-wheel-free design and is part of the company's push toward an autonomous future.

However, the purchase comes with notable restrictions. According to the fine print, the Cybercab will only be available in supported service areas. This means interested buyers must reside in specific regions where the vehicle's operation is supported in order to complete a purchase.
